body.raw:
{
  "clientName": "Sample Customer",
  "phone": "9000000001",
  "pujaName": "Rudrabhishek Puja",
  "pujaDate": "2026-08-19",
  "pujaTime": "10:00",
  "totalAmount": 2600,
  "tokenAmount": 99,
  "tokenStatus": "received",
  "totalAmountStatus": "pending",
  "samagriIncluded": true,
  "transactionId": "UPI123456",
  "address": "Sample address, City",
  "notes": "Customer confirmed via phone call",
  "status": "confirmed"
}

request.description:
Every field is optional — only include what actually changed in the CRM. Omitted fields are left untouched on the website. `transactionId` accepts explicit `null` to clear it. `samagriIncluded: false` only clears the package-level flag — it can't hide samagri the customer actually selected and paid for on the website (see toCrmBookingPayload). `status` should only be sent on the one transition worth syncing: "confirmed" or "notConverted".

⚠️ Double-check {{website_booking_id}} / the URL before sending — this overwrites real booking data with whatever is in this body.
